column2: Working rule
A shared planning workbook for copy, UX/design, SEO/AEO, research review, and social-content planning before the website is built.
Serve all relevant SMARTfit institutional markets. Do not design the site around a single vertical.

Robert confirms the PDF collection came from SMARTfit and SMARTfit content came from its Google Drive sales tools. The workbook records this user-reported provenance; it does not independently verify every claim.
Manufacturer sales collateral can describe how SMARTfit presents products. It is not automatically independent scientific evidence, current product documentation, or permission to make every claim.
No candidate claim in this workbook is approved for publication. Only exact, reviewed wording supported by an appropriate source may later be marked approved.
Use extracted text to find passages, then verify the original PDF page, version, diagrams, tables, fine print, and context.
Search topics are hypotheses from prior query exploration and buyer language, not validated search volumes, rankings, or demand estimates.
Robert confirms permission to offer the SMARTfit Brain Health PDF and that the demo access in it is intended for prospects. Do not edit or rebrand it without separate authorization.

SMARTfit products are currently available; Texas is Robert's territory and he can make sales beyond Texas. Specific product orderability, fulfillment, service, and authorized-dealer wording still need confirmation.
Keep pricing private. Do not put pricing or inferred commercial terms into public pages, metadata, or client-side code.
Platinum Service Plan 1-01-24.pdf is included and page-extracted; filename date is not verified as effective date, and current terms remain unconfirmed. Keep all rates internal.

Robert aims to grow online SMARTfit sales toward a future physical product-demonstration location, with possible Hypergravity integration. This is aspirational; there is no confirmed site, funding plan, service model, partnership, or opening date. See strategy/business-vision-and-phases.md.

58 sitemap-listed NeuroAdaption Center pages reviewed on 2026-10-27; this is a public-content/claims review, not validation of medical, regulatory, or reimbursement claims. See strategy/neuroadaption-site-review.md.
Use filters, keep sources and statuses with each row, record decisions in Open Questions, and update this workbook when manufacturer documents or approved business facts change.
